references.context: Topology: an open set U containing the indicated point x of the ambient space, not a general neighborhood that need not be open.
references.matching_note: Provisional context-specific missing concept requiring global identity audit.

references.phrase: disjoint open neighborhoods of distinct points
references.disposition: The separation of arbitrary distinct x and y by disjoint open neighborhoods is the defining Hausdorff condition.
The separation property applies to every distinct pair; it does not require singleton sets to be open.
